outcome: two-hour oral glucose tolerance test glucose
cohort: This study included 651 women aged 18 years or older who received specialized antenatal care for GDM between January 2008 and November 2021.
finding: Elevated TG/HDL ratios were associated with a poorer cardiometabolic profile and a higher likelihood of GDM diagnosis in the second or third trimester.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rates were higher in the highest TG/HDL ratio tertile.
cross-section timing: TG/HDL ratio was assessed during the second or third trimester.
